name: Birmingham, Alabama, 27 April 2011 (midday balloon)
line: Unstable air (CAPE about 2800 J/kg) with very strong wind shear (35 m/s over 6 km) that turns sharply near the ground.
note: The balloon launched at 1800 UTC (1 pm local time). The storm is started by a gentle push of rising air, as CM1's updraft nudging does. In a 1 km run the storm lasts the whole two hours (measured). This day's sounding in an idealized storm, not a reconstruction of that day's storms.

gm1_settings_why: The push of rising air that starts the storm is centred 4.7 km east and 10.4 km south of the centre, the storm-track check's recommended place for this sounding, so the storm keeps the most room to every side. CM1 keeps the nudging's centre in its code (xc_wnudge, yc_wnudge), not the namelist, so this is a GM1 setting.
